assertions.description: Output does NOT use hardcoded hex values in component code

Output references Sovereign Gold identity color

Output does NOT use purple/violet/indigo as primary or brand color
Output references anti-slop philosophy, forbidden defaults, or Template Test

assertions.description: Output avoids recommending standard 50/50 hero split layout

assertions.description: Output includes prefers-reduced-motion when animation code is present
Output does NOT use tiny body text sizes (10-12px)
Output references alternative layouts when designing hero or landing page sections
